snippet.title: Wukong's Journey DLC Trailer | Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance
snippet.description:
Three ruthless demons escaped their ancient prisons and stole the orbs that gave Sun Wukong his legendary power. If they unlock their secrets, the entire Kingdom could fall into chaos! Luckily, the Alliance knows a thing or two about world-ending threats. 🐵🍑 Wishlist Wukong’s Journey on Steam now! ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732970/Kingdom_Rush_5_Alliance_TD__Wukongs_Journey_Campaign?utm_source=youtube_trailer&utm_campaign=wukong

🌸🐲  DLC CONTENTS 🐲🌸
- 5 Dangerous New Stages: explore ancient mystical islands!
- 23 Deadly Enemies: from mythical creatures to iron-clad warriors!
- 3 Demon Bosses: Red Boy, Princess Iron Fan, and the Bull Demon King!
- 1 New Hero: The legendary Monkey King, Sun Wukong, joins the Alliance!
- 1 New Tower: Panda Trio – skadoosh your way to victory!
- New Mechanic: Harness the power of the elements with Elemental Holders!
- 4 New Achievements to conquer (and brag about!)
- Easter eggs packed with ancient surprises!

Coming September 25th to Android, iOS, and Steam.
Are you ready to monkey around with destiny? 
🌐 https://www.kingdomrushalliance.com/
